title.narrative: To improve governance within the Namibian CBNRM programme

description.narrative: The National CBNRM Programme is facing governance challenges which could eventually undermine the success of more than 30 years of innovative work, significant progress and the longterm sustainability of the programme. The focus of the proposed action is to address the key challenges of increasing accountability of conservancy management structures to their members and in turn, retaining community employment and where possible, increasing benefits to members through an increased level of engagement with decision making. The proposed activities will support the achievement of each output and thus the outcome. When conservancy members are more engaged and holding management (committees) accountable, governance throughout the National CBNRM Programme will be improved. This improvement in governance will result in retained community employment, amidst COVID19 impacts on tourism and conservancy income, leading to improved livelihoods and continued support for conservation of natural resources. Best practice and lessons learned through the action will be shared and implemented across the national programme.
